title: NHK Web やさしい日本語 — SNSと日常生活 (Social Media and Daily Life)
description: NHK Web Easy news segment on how social media has changed daily life in Japan. Covers usage trends of LINE, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), and TikTok among different age groups, the phenomenon of 'SNS疲れ' (social media fatigue), and efforts by schools to address smartphone and social media use. Modern vocabulary including many loanwords.
